app.name: Dobleuno
home.eyebrow: Warhammer: The Old World · Tabletop companion
home.subheadline: Lists, battles and rules of The Old World in your hand. No communities, no leaderboards. Just you, your army and an assistant that knows what's up.
home.section.features.title: Lists, Battle,
home.section.features.lede: Three tabs, one hand. Open the app and jump into what you were doing. The screen stays dark to save battery and your eyes.
home.feature.codex.title: Rulebook
home.feature.codex.desc: Mirror of tow.whfb.app. Search a rule, read the citation, settle the question.
home.feature.listas.title: Armies
home.feature.listas.desc: Build, validate, save. The composition is checked as you type.
home.feature.mesas.title: Club tables
home.feature.mesas.desc: Sign up to a session, see who's playing, reserve your spot.
home.section.oracle.title: Ask.
home.section.oracle.lede: When there's a critical situation and both players are unsure, the oracle answers with the rule, the citation and the most likely interpretation.
home.oracle.ask: My Knight of the Realm wants to charge through a forest. Legal charge? Does the forest give cover?
home.oracle.answer: The charge is legal: the forest doesn't prevent declaring the charge, it only affects the movement. Cover (+1 to save) is only granted against ranged attacks, not melee combat.
home.section.roadmap.title: MVP under construction
home.section.roadmap.lede: One wave per week. You play at the table and give feedback while I code.

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.privacy.s1.body: Email and name (for your account), and optionally an avatar. Your army lists and battles are stored on our server to sync across your devices. We log IP and user-agent on each login for security.
legal.privacy.s2.body: On a Postgres server located in the European Union (Hetzner). Backups follow the same jurisdiction.
legal.privacy.s3.body: Your rules questions are sent to the DeepSeek API (China) and the OpenAI API (USA) to generate AI answers. We do not sell your data to third parties.
legal.privacy.s4.body: You can download all your data (profile, lists, battles) as JSON from your account section, or ask us to delete them completely. To exercise any of these rights, contact us via the GitHub repository.
legal.privacy.s5.body: We only use session cookies (needed to keep you logged in). We do not use tracking or analytics cookies.
legal.privacy.s6.body: If we make material changes, we will announce them in the project CHANGELOG and README.
legal.terms.s1.body: Dobleuno is a free, open-source (CC BY 4.0) companion app for Warhammer: The Old World players. Its only purpose is to assist players during their tabletop games: list building, battle tracking, and rules search.
legal.terms.s2.body: Dobleuno is distributed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0). You can use it, fork it, modify it, and redistribute it, even commercially, as long as you maintain attribution to the original author.
legal.terms.s3.body: Dobleuno is NOT affiliated with, sponsored by, endorsed by, or approved by Games Workshop. Warhammer, The Old World, Games Workshop, Citadel, and all associated trademarks are property of Games Workshop Limited. Use of these trademarks in Dobleuno is exclusively nominative (reference to the game the app is about) and implies no endorsement.
legal.terms.s4.body: Rules content is sourced from the community site tow.whfb.app, which maintains a mirror of Games Workshop's official publications. Dobleuno paraphrases and codifies these mechanics, it does not reproduce extensive literal text. Use is under fair use / nominative use, for non-commercial purposes.
legal.terms.s5.body: Dobleuno is provided "as is". We do not guarantee that the rules oracle's answers are correct or complete — always verify with the official rulebook and Games Workshop errata. The project is not responsible for in-game errors derived from use of the app.
legal.terms.s6.body: Dobleuno is an assistance tool. Final decisions in a game are made by the players. The project is not responsible for disputes, tournament sanctions, or any consequence derived from relying on the app's answers.
legal.terms.s7.body: For legal questions or issue reports, open an issue in the project's public repository.
